## Correction

The frozen oracle `tests/test_effort_brief.py` had two defects, found by this task's executor and confirmed by the parent. The parent fixed them on `phase/effort-brief` (commit 81eadd1bd) with the user's approval, then re-recorded the red runs and refreshed `oracle_hashes` on the acceptances R1-R8.

1. R3: each parametrized case now creates its control brief under its own subject (`control-<section>`). The shared subject `control` collided with canon's one-active-record-per-subject rule.
2. R4: the test reads `record["record_type"]`, the key `canon create` returns. It read `record["type"]`.

The intent of every test is unchanged. No assertion was weakened. The task branch merges the phase tip before it is verified.
